advanced_metallurgy.name: Advanced Metallurgy
advanced_metallurgy.description: High-grade metal fabrication and alloy synthesis.

combat_armor.name: Combat Armor
combat_armor.description: Standard ballistic armor construction for front-line soldiers.

tactical_systems.name: Tactical Systems
tactical_systems.description: Modular armor systems with integrated gear mounts and HUD support.

reinforced_plating.name: Reinforced Plating
reinforced_plating.description: Heavy ballistic plating for maximum protection at the cost of mobility.

stealth_module.name: Stealth Module
stealth_module.description: Signal-dampening and thermal-masking materials for covert operations.

thermal_insulation.name: Thermal Insulation
thermal_insulation.description: Ablative and ceramic composites that protect against extreme heat and plasma.

powered_exoskeleton.name: Powered Exoskeleton
powered_exoskeleton.description: Servo-assisted plate armor that negates the mobility penalty of heavy protection.

radiation_shielding.name: Radiation Shielding
radiation_shielding.description: Lead-composite and field-dampening materials for radiation protection.

advanced_radiation_shielding.name: Advanced Radiation Shielding
advanced_radiation_shielding.description: Full-spectrum radiation protection rated for reactor cores and hot zones.

fuel_refining.name: Fuel Refining
fuel_refining.description: Techniques for processing biomass and ore into refined fuel cells for the ship's drive.

global_inv_current.name: Inventory Survey
global_inv_current.description: Networked locker telemetry for a single site. Adds the Current Site tab to the Global Inventory.

global_inv_all.name: Fleet Census
global_inv_all.description: Subspace ledger that aggregates storage across the ship hold and every established site. Adds the All Sites tab.

global_inv_detailed.name: Detailed Census
global_inv_detailed.description: Per-site breakdown of the fleet census. Adds the By Site tab to the Global Inventory.

encyclopedia.name: Archive Indexing
encyclopedia.description: Cross-references field observations into an indexed bestiary. Unlocks the Encyclopedia on the Star Map. Entities continue to be recorded as you encounter them, even before this research finishes.

robotics.name: Robotics
robotics.description: Servo control, power cells, and chassis fabrication. Unlocks the Robot Workbench and the Hauler Robot recipe.

excavator_robotics.name: Excavator Robotics
excavator_robotics.description: Drilling rigs and reinforced manipulators for an autonomous mining unit.

security_robotics.name: Security Robotics
security_robotics.description: Targeting cortex and weapon mounts for an autonomous combat unit.

construction_robotics.name: Construction Robotics
construction_robotics.description: Precision actuators and structural assembly routines for an autonomous builder.
